description: This file contains the definition of the Location class within the Opencart Admin Model Localisation namespace, implementing CRUD operations for location entities in the system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, retrieving a single location, retrieving multiple locations, and counting total locations.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents the Location model in the Opencart system, providing methods for CRUD operations related to locations.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Inserts a new location record into the database using provided data, returning the new location ID.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Updates an existing location identified by location_id with the supplied data.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes the location record associated with the given location_id.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific location by location_id.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of locations, optionally sorted and paginated based on provided data.

methods.name: getTotalLocations
methods.description: Returns the total count of location records in the database.
